submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit Image 1 into ONE independent transparent RGBA game animation frame, run/SW/06. Image 2 is the approved primary painting style only. Image 3 shows the anatomical leg ownership and support direction in the preceding phase; do not copy its whole pose. This is the same cute brown high ponytail bamboo archer girl, facing diagonally toward screen lower-left. STRICTLY preserve Image1 head, face, hair, body size, shoulders, hands, bow, quiver, upper costume, camera and canvas placement. Full long bamboo bow stays in anatomical LEFT hand, anatomical RIGHT hand empty, quiver anatomical RIGHT shoulder. Change ONLY the articulated legs/shorts/lower hem necessary for this action. The anatomical RIGHT leg is the TRAILING leg toward screen-right: extend this right thigh backward from its correct hip, then bend the knee softly so the right boot REACHES THE INVISIBLE GROUND and its forefoot visibly remains planted in the far trailing position. It must NOT be tucked up in flight. Its heel may rise modestly while the forefoot and toe pad bear weight; do not show the whole sole toward the camera. Toe long axis points forward toward lower-left with the shin and knee, no sideways ankle rotation. The anatomical LEFT thigh is forward at screen-left, bent up, with left boot airborne, preparing next stride; keep that existing raised-left-knee identity. Weight is visibly supported by the trailing right forefoot, body passes in front of it, pelvis slightly flexed/compressed without moving the whole figure. Right support toe approximately screen x640-680, y960-980 on this 1024 canvas, boot full inside canvas, not farther sideways. This is seventh of eight consecutive RIGHT support frames, not a flying pose. It is distinct from05, with left shin beginning to unfold while right knee gently extends; full right contact continues into07. Preserve bright clean rounded jade/ivory/gold hand-painted detail. No background, ground drawing, shadow, effects, labels, extra feet, arrow or weapon, scale change, copied pose, collage or interpolation. True alpha transparency, native at least1024.
